create_dirichlet_distribution: create a Dirichlet distribution with a concentration parameter alpha array of length K >= 2
sample_from_dirichlet: sample random values from a Dirichlet distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a value under a Dirichlet distribution
calculate_entropy: calculate the Shannon entropy in nats for a Dirichlet distribution
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two Dirichlet or Beta distributions
